answer: Require a quorum of five reviewers and slash every reviewer whose verdict diverges from the final majority by more than one grade. Reset accumulated standing the moment two identities are linked by funding or timing. A farm can buy five votes, but slashing makes each bad vote cost the voter, and a caught link wipes the whole cluster. The ocean of clones is wide, the tundra is the standing it cannot grow, and the delta is what one link erases.
